projects.name: Government of Bahrain has strengthened capacity to promote ethical recruitment of migrant workers and relevant stakeholders are equipped with tailored information and skills to address recruitment-related vulnerabilities and support migrant workers and employers with facilitating labor migration processes
projects.description:
1.	Train recruitment agencies in Bahrain on ethical recruitment practices and policies through IOM's International Recruitment Integrity System (IRIS)
2.     Support the capacity of the Government of Bahrain to effectively promote ethical recruitment and enhance foreign workers' access to comprehensive orientation programmes upon their arrival and during their time in Bahrain through the development and roll-out of a tailored orientation programmes and awareness raising campaigns.

21/22
- Leverage the use of technology through the launch of an app to better job-match between eligible workers and employers, strengthening recruitment practices.
- Train recruitment agencies in Bahrain on ethical recruitment practices and policies through IOM's International Recruitment Integrity System (IRIS)
- Support private sector actors by piloting the Fair Hiring pledge with Bahrain-based companies and organizations.
- Conduct research to identify and address the systematic vulnerabilities faced by migrant domestic workers.
- Support the capacity of the Government of Bahrain to effectively promote ethical recruitment and enhance foreign workers' access to comprehensive orientation programmes upon their arrival through the development and roll-out of a national post arrival orientation programme. 

Additional Details:
- This project, in partnership with the Bahrain Labour Market Regulatory Authority and STC aims to launch an app in Bahrain to better job-match between eligible workers and employers and strengthen recruitment practices, including offering a secure payment transaction solution.
- Training workshops to introduce participants to the standards and tools under 'International Recruitment Integrity (IRIS). This will support recruitment agencies to address unethical recruitment practices and reduce risks to workers within their recruitment chains.
- This project will involve awareness-raising sessions with workforces on promoting a better understanding of recruitment and employment of domestic workers, including rights and obligations and guidance. 
- This project will identify and comprehensive analyze the spectrum of vulnerabilities that migrant domestic workers face from the point of their arrival to their departure, using primary and secondary data collection.
- This project will involve awareness-raising sessions with workforces on promoting a better understanding of recruitment and employment of domestic workers, including rights and obligations and guidance. 
- The development and roll-out of a national post-arrival orientation programme for newly-arrived foreign workers in the private sector, including the design of all training materials and training trainers and programme managers
projects.outcome: 09. Relevant institutions promote development-oriented policies and tools that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, and access social protection measures for workers.
